Shared macro regime:** Broad tape is **mildly risk-on** — ES premarket +0.31%, NQ +0.55% (green futures), Asia composite +0.1% (mixed), Europe +0.13% (mildly positive), VIX calm at 15.21, Fear & Greed 56.8 (Greed). For REITs, the macro tape is dominated by rates, and the rate backdrop is turning positive.

**2. Rates / real yields (dominant driver):**
- **10Y real yield (TIPS): 2.32%, 1d -0.06, 1w -0.09, 1m -0.12** — real yields FALLING across all timeframes, including 1m now clearly negative. This is the spine positive.
- **10Y: 4.64%, 1d -0.06, 1w -0.07** — easing.
- **30Y: 5.17%, 1d -0.06, 1w -0.11, 1m +0.05** — easing today but still elevated (near 19-year high zone).
- **PCE printed July: core held at 3.3% YoY (in-line), headline 3.7% (slightly above 3.6% forecast)** — core in-line is the Fed's preferred gauge, mildly positive for rate-sensitive sectors. Headline slightly hot is a tempering factor.
- **Fed's Collins hawkish** — rate hike may be needed soon; regional Fed directors sought hike before July hold.
- **Warsh Jackson Hole speech Friday** — two-sided catalyst.

**3. Spine factors:**
- **Rates falling / REIT duration relief:** PARTIAL HIT — yields easing today (10Y -0.06, 30Y -0.06, real -0.06) on an oil-slide/easing-inflation mechanism. Per the 08-25 lesson, this is a positive/neutral rate spine. But the 08-21 level-vs-change lesson tempers this because 30Y at 5.17% is still elevated near a 19-year high.
- **Rates rising / REIT selloff:** NOT firing — yields are easing, not rising.
- **Real yields falling:** POSITIVE HIT — DFII10 -0.09 1w, -0.12 1m.

**4. Secondary factors:**
- **Data-center REIT demand / rent upside:** POSITIVE HIT — strong, AI-driven, vacancy <3%, record hyperscaler capex. Structural, not a same-day catalyst.
- **Industrial REIT occupancy / rent growth:** POSITIVE HIT — PLD ~95% occupancy, strong rent growth.
- **Office vacancy / mark-to-market stress:** NEGATIVE — national vacancy still ~17-19%, office remains the stressed sleeve.
- **Refinancing wall stress:** NEGATIVE — ~$875B-$930B CRE/multifamily maturities clustered in 2026 at 6-7% reset rates.
- **Refinancing window / cap-rate compression:** NOT opening — long-end still ~5.17%, no compression signal.

**5. Breadth / leadership:** Healthcare/senior (WELL ~11%) and data-center/industrial large-caps are carrying XLRE. Roughly a third of REIT names in an uptrend; office still dead money. That is **large-cap / low-beta leadership**, not breadth expansion. Single-name rule: WELL cannot define XLRE.

**6. Flows / positioning:** XLRE 5d outflows noted in prior runs. REITs averaging 13.81% YTD total return (strong). No confirmed same-day flow spike. Not a crowded long on 1m (still -5.40% rel).

**7. Earnings / policy:** No fresh REIT print this morning. Policy catalyst is **PCE (just printed in-line core) + Warsh Jackson Hole Friday** — two-sided, not scored as already hawkish or already dovish.

### Self-audit
- **Lens:** duration/rates for a bond-proxy sector, not an SPX beta call.
- **Band:** factors net mildly positive; do not emit notable off a 1d negative tape and still-elevated long-end level.
- **Skew:** easing rate tape + in-line core PCE vs headline-hot + hawkish Collins + Warsh Friday — two-sided, not one-way up.
- **Same-shock:** the yield easing is counted once as "positive rate spine," not again as S1 duration HIT and S4 thesis.
- **Single-ticker:** WELL/EQIX/DLR are dispersion, not the ETF call.

### Divergence
Leading (S0+S1+S2+S3) = **+2**. Tape S4 = **0**. **Flagged.** Trust factors over tape: the easing rate spine and in-line core PCE argue mildly positive, but the 1d tape is negative (-0.62% rel) and the 30Y level is still elevated. This is a mild positive bias, not a strong up call.

**Call implication for the pipeline:** Σ = +2 × 0.9 = **+1.8 → up/flat**. Absolute XLRE can print a few tenths either way; the environment is a contained post-PCE standoff into Warsh Friday, not a duration-relief rally and not a fresh long-end shock.

## 0. Facts

Absolute ~−1% and relative ~−1.6% is **down / notable**, not the morning’s up/mild.

## 1. What drove the sector
Primary driver was a **live long-end backup into Warsh Friday**, not the prior-close easing the morning treated as the spine.

- Hoya’s close recap: equity REITs **−1.0%** vs S&P **+0.7%**; 10Y **4.67% (+3 bps)**, 30Y **5.19% (+2 bps)**, 2Y **4.23% (+2 bps)**. That is the REIT duration factor firing **against** the morning S0/S1 read.
- The “risk-on” tape was **not** duration-friendly beta. Nvidia’s 8/26 after-close print (rev $96.22B, DC $89B, bullish guide) produced a **tech-only** SPX: IT ~+3%, **10 of 11 sectors down**. XLRE was in the discarded sleeve, not the AI bid.
- Event risk stayed two-sided: Warsh still spoke Friday; Collins called July PCE “mixed,” policy “mildly restrictive,” and left a hike door open. That is not duration relief.
- Supply: $44B 7-year notes stopped at **4.512%** (highest since Dec 2024), modest tail — consistent with a still-stressed coupon market, not a refinancing window.
- Morning oil-slide/easing-inflation mechanism **did not persist**. Hoya had crude **$83.67, +1.8%**. The 08-25 “oil down = REIT-positive spine” mapping was stale by the close.

Taxonomy: **rates rising / REIT selloff** HIT; **real yields falling** MISS on the live day; **risk-on / equity beta expansion** MISS for this sector (narrow mega-cap, not REIT beta).

Office is ~1% of XLRE — not the ETF. | **Over-scored.** Same-day REIT factor is the curve, not mid-year occupancy notes. |
| **S2 0** | 1d rel −0.62%, 1w rel +0.61%, large-cap/low-beta leadership | Breadth stayed narrow; housing −1.1%; VICI new 52w low | **Fair.** Did not pretend breadth was expanding. |

Morning also internally contradicted itself: narrative said Σ +1.8 → **up/flat** and flagged divergence, but the pipeline emitted **up/mild** with `divergence_flagged: False`. The published call was the optimistic one.

**Lessons that should have capped or flipped the call (and were only half-applied):**
- **08-17 live-rate reversal:** do not lock S0/S1 off *yesterday’s* −6 bp print. Today the curve went the other way.
- **08-21 level-vs-change:** 30Y still ~5.17–5.19% (19-year-high zone). A 6 bp dip is not duration relief. This was named, then overridden.
- **08-25 oil-slide/easing-inflation:** only valid if oil *stays* down and yields *stay* easier. Neither held.
- **08-18 relative bid is a mag cap:** 1w rel +0.61% was already fading (1d rel −0.62%). Using it as residual up-bias was the error.

---

## 3. Interactions / double-count / knowable-at-open

**Interaction (one shock, two sleeves):** Nvidia-only SPX strength **plus** a 2–3 bp long-end backup is the same rotation: capital into AI duration-insensitive names, out of bond proxies. Do not score “risk-on S0 +1” and “REIT duration S1 +1” as independent positives when the risk-on *is* the thing selling REITs.

**Double-count in the morning:** real-yield HIT and “rates falling / duration PARTIAL” were the same 6 bp move, counted twice into S0 and S1. That manufactured the +2 leading sum.

**Knowable at open: partially.**
- Known: sticky 3.7%/3.3% PCE, Collins hike optionality, Warsh Friday, 30Y still elevated, XLRE 1d already −0.62% rel, NVDA print already out.
- Not known: exact +3/+2 bp live backup, 7-year tail, oil reversing +1.8%, VICI 52w low.
- The miss was not “Warsh spoke hawkish” (he hadn’t). It was treating a **stale easing snapshot** as the live spine when the open already had a two-sided event and a fading 1d tape.

---

## 4. Outliers inside the sector
- **VICI** printed a fresh 52-week low (~$25.75) — long-lease/experiential duration, not office.
- **Housing index −1.1%** vs equity REITs −1.0%: rate beta, not a single-name XLRE story.
- **Office** remains structurally ugly but is ~1% of XLRE; it did not drive the ETF.
- **Data-center/AI REITs** did not offset the duration hit. NVDA strength stayed in semiconductors/software (CRM, CRWD), not EQIX/DLR enough to lift XLRE.
- Nareit North America **−0.92%**, FTSE EPRA Americas **−0.89%**: the flush was index-wide, not an XLRE idiosyncratic.
